rows.survey.md: | [**TCP4D**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23143v1) | 2026 | TCP tracking on DROID and RoboLab; 48 RoboTwin tasks; CoBoT Magic pen placement and bowl stacking | Shared 4D scene representation tracks TCP poses and gripper states from RGB video; flow matching generates future actions; cross-embodiment augmentation without recorded source-robot states | RoboTwin success: 69.19% clean2clean, 10.94% clean2random; CoBoT Magic mean success: 78.33% across two tasks | — |
rows.survey_ko.md: | [**TCP4D**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23143v1) | 2026 | DROID·RoboLab의 TCP 추적; RoboTwin 과제 48개; CoBoT Magic의 펜 놓기·그릇 쌓기 | 공유 4D 장면 표현으로 RGB 영상의 TCP 자세와 gripper 상태를 추적한다. Flow matching으로 미래 행동을 생성하며, 기록된 원본 로봇 상태 없이 cross-embodiment 증강을 수행한다 | RoboTwin 성공률: clean2clean 69.19%, clean2random 10.94%; CoBoT Magic 두 과제 평균 성공률: 78.33% | — |
